narrative.overview: A near-black page lit by two slow lime fields, with liquid-glass panes in front (translucent gradient, bright top edge, diagonal sheen) and a single lime pen that draws sketches, ticks headings and underlines emphasis. Wide heavy uppercase Roboto Flex headings over plain reading text; entries carry their metadata under the title. Full width up to 1720px, square corners everywhere; no graph grid, no margin rule.
keyCharacteristics: One black ramp plus ink; lime is the only chroma, used as marker and as ambient light.
Translucent, square-cornered glass panes with a lit top edge; buttons, inputs and photos are square too.
Wide uppercase display type; lime single-stroke drawings that take the form of the question they answer.
Motion is drawing, run once; nothing animates under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Lime marks: strokes, ticks, underlines, the primary action, focus. It never fills a panel or colours body text. The one exception is light, not paint: the body light fields and the soft lime glows behind the hero sketch and the CTA are ambient and sit behind glass.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Any solid grey is a ramp step. Translucent white is the glass material, not a grey.

rules.name: The Warn Rule
rules.body: Warn appears only on invalid fields and form status errors.

rules.name: The Under Rule
rules.body: Entry and metadata lines sit under their title, never above; no eyebrow or kicker above any heading.

rules.name: The Wide Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for headings, buttons and labels; reading text stays sentence case.

rules.name: The Frosting Rule
rules.body: Blur is for panes that content passes behind. A static card gets the gradient, edge and sheen, never a backdrop filter.

rules.name: The Solid Fallback Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-transparency every pane, the nav overlay and the play chip become solid Black 2 (#111316) with no blur.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: No rounded corners anywhere. New components use the radius tokens (all 0) or none, never a literal radius.

dos: Do keep every corner square (radius tokens are 0).
Do put the real logo image top-left in the floating glass bar; use Roboto Flex throughout.
Do use lime only as marker.
Do keep solid greys on the ramp; build panes from the glass tokens.
Do blur only panes that content scrolls behind (header, hero, form plate, CTA).
Do provide the solid Black 2 fallback for any new pane under prefers-reduced-transparency.
Do draw a diagram in the form of the question it answers.
Do put entry and metadata lines under titles.
Do keep videos and the map behind a click.
Do keep the stats caveat with any stats.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above any heading.
Don't round any corner: no radius, no pills.
Don't use hard offset shadows, glyph icons or another display face.
Don't use lime for body text or panel fills; its only non-marker use is ambient light behind glass.
Don't use Warn outside form errors.
Don't reintroduce the graph-paper grid or the margin rule.
